title: The Schur--Zassenhaus Theorem and Sylow's Third Theorem for Finite Skew Braces
summary: In this short note we establish the Schur--Zassenhaus Theorem and Sylow's Third Theorem for finite skew braces. More precisely, we prove that every Hall ideal of a finite skew brace admits a sub-skew brace complement, and more generally that every left ideal whose order is coprime to that of the Hall ideal can be embedded in such a complement. Using similar ideas we show that every left ideal of prime-power order is contained in a Sylow sub-skew brace.
